Despite some fluctuations in demand, the business maintained healthy margins, with cost controls and efficiency measures helping to offset any increase in operational expenses. The company’s operating income saw an uptick, indicating that the firm was able to manage its administrative and selling expenses effectively, while also benefiting from a more streamlined supply chain.
